description: The last block at or before a given time (unix seconds/ms or ISO 8601) on base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, gnosis or celo, with its timestamp and the next block's, so you can pin eth_call reads, audits and snapshots to a moment. Batched k-ary search over live block headers (about 7 round trips). Very old history may be unavailable on public nodes. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402 (MCP transport: an unpaid call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over HTTP: GET /api/block-at-time.

time.description: unix seconds, unix ms, or ISO 8601 (UTC)

name: block_at_time
title: Block number at a timestamp (8 EVM chains)
